tagline: The updated equipment box enclosure is designed to notify technicians of any environmental issues that may pose a threat to crucial hardware and cause disruptions to clients' internet services.

story.whatItDoes: Monitors the temperature within an enclosed environment and reacts appropriately. While analyzing the data to predict future weather failure conditions
story.howWeBuiltIt: Arduino, python, Google Collab, Google Cloud, Rasberry Pi os
story.challengesWeRanInto: Raspberry Pi cooperation, Color base thermal detection calibration
story.accomplishmentsWeAreProudOf: Accomplish our goals and make the plan come to fruition without much deviation.
